ACT VIII OF 2009
ACT VIII OF 2009
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE
CIVIL
SERVANTS (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2009
An Act further to amend
the North-West Frontier Province
Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary,
28th March, 2009]
No.PA/NWFP/Bills/2009/11783, dated 28-3-2009.---The North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants
(Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on 17th March, 2009 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 20th March, 2009 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants Act, 1973 (N.-W.F.P.
Act No.XVIII of 1973), for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants (Amendment) Act,
2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 20th March, 2009 is hereby

Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants Act, 1973 (N.-W.F.P.
Act No.XVIII of 1973), for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment of section 19 of N.-W.F.P., Act
No.XVIII of 1973.---In
the North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants Act, 1973 (N.-W.F.P. Act No.XVIII of 1973), in section 19, in subsection (2), in the
existing proviso, the word "further" shall be inserted after the word
"Provided" and before the existing proviso, as so amended, the
following new proviso shall be inserted, namely:--
"Provided that
where a civil servant appointed to a pensionable post
on regular basis before the 1st day of July, 2001, is appointed to another post
after the 1st day of July, 2001, without any service break, he shall be given an option
either to retain the benefit of pension and gratuity as allowed to him under
his previous terms of appointment or to avail the benefit of Contributory
provident Fund allowed to him under this new appointment.
